Ready to keep North America’s supply chain moving? We are looking for a highly dynamic student to join us for a full-time (40h/week), temporary 4-month internship running from May to August 2027. This exciting program connects you directly with senior leaders and our active business operations through specialized cohort workshops, operational site tours, and exclusive networking activities!

Join us today and get your career moving!

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Intern Software Engineering Developer collaborates with experienced software engineers and cross-functional team members to design, develop, test, and support software solutions that address business and customer needs. As part of an Agile team, the intern will gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects while learning software development best practices, modern engineering tools, and industry-standard technologies.The intern will work alongside professionals in various roles, including Software Engineers, Technical Leads, Product Owners, Quality Engineers, DevOps Engineers, UX Designers, and other technology specialists. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop technical skills, gain exposure to the full software development lifecycle, and work with modern technologies and frameworks that are widely used across the industry.

**Main Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Contribute to the development and enhancement of new and existing software applications, services, and technology solutions.
* Assist in designing, coding, testing, debugging, and maintaining software components under the guidance of experienced team members.
* Participate in creating and executing automated and manual test cases to help ensure software quality and reliability.
* Support application deployments and learn modern software delivery and DevOps practices.
* Contribute to the documentation of software designs, technical solutions, processes, and user guides.
* Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing activities to learn software engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with cross-functional team members, including developers, quality engineers, product owners, and technical leads.
* Assist in troubleshooting and resolving software issues in development, testing, and production environments.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and engineering practices while contributing to team objectives.

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* The role involves managing priorities and delivering work within established timelines, with support from the team to ensure sustainable and effective workload management.
* This position operates in a professional office environment and follows a regular Monday to Friday work schedule, with standard business hours.
* The incumbent must be available to work in a hybrid model, requiring a minimum of four (4) days per week in the office, with opportunities for remote work in accordance with company policies and business needs.
* This role also requires the ability to work legally in Canada and or the U.S.

**Experience**
--------------

* Good knowledge of Java and Python programming language.
* Basic knowledge of Database Management System (DBMS).
* Basic knowledge of Spring Boot Java programing framework.
* Basic knowledge of Continuous Integration Principles (DevOps).
* Basic knowledge of production support and troubleshooting.
* High motivation in learning.
* Soft skills with aptitudes in critical thinking of software solutions.
* Basic knowledge of Python Wheels or Python Notebooks\*.
* Basic knowledge of front-end development (web or mobile).
* Apply analytical thinking to solve problems.
* Time management with strong analytical skills with attention to detail.
* Communicate with impact both orally and written.
* Strong ability to collaborate and share timely information with and across functions to get things done effectively.
* Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
* Autonomous, resourceful, and has an investigative and project ownership mindset.
* + Any experience/education/skills/knowledge for these above would be considered as an asset

**Education/Certification/Designation**
---------------------------------------

* Working towards a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering

**Competencies**
----------------

* We Care About Each Other
* We Strive for Excellence
* We Succeed Together
* We Lead Responsibly

**Technical Skills/Knowledge**
------------------------------

* Fluently bilingual, both written and verbal (English, French)\*

-----------------------------------

N/A

CN is a premium railroad that sustainably generates value for our customers, shareholders, employees, and stakeholders with an unwavering commitment to safety and service. Essential to the economy, to the customers, and to the communities it serves, CN safely transports more than 300 million tons of natural resources, manufactured products, and finished goods throughout North America every year. CN's network connects Canada’s Eastern and Western coasts with the U.S. South through an 18,800-mile rail network. CN and its affiliates have been contributing to community prosperity and sustainable trade since 1919.
